remarks: Beautifully maintained 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom Cape Cod home nestled on Old Stone Road in the heart of Darien just a very short distance to the Darien Train station, Whole Foods and the new Corbin District. This home offers the perfect blend of small-town charm and modern convenience including an updated kitchen with new appliances, a dedicated work-from-home space, and abundant natural light throughout. French doors lead to the fully fenced-in backyard complete with a spacious patio perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining. Award winning schools and beautiful beaches make #4 Old Stone Road a place to call home.
